operations.title: 1251 — The Five-Cycle Canonical Integrand Occupies Every Kummer Character
operations.body: Exact Walsh–Hadamard transforms at two generic rational points show nonzero components in all 32 C2^5 characters. Hence the 32 deck translates of the source canonical integrand have generic rank 32. Any smaller integrated system must arise from de Rham relations, physical-cycle pairing, support specialization, or a constructed derived quotient.

operations.title: Benincasa finds maximal Kummer character support for the five-cycle integrand
operations.body: Entry 1251: exact all-sheet Walsh–Hadamard decomposition of the source canonical function has all 32 C2^5 characters nonzero at two independent generic rational samples. The generic deck span is rank 32. Thus cyclic compression saves term compilation but does not reduce coefficient rank; any lower-rank period system must be derived cohomologically or by the physical relative cycle, with character labels retained.
